verdicts.quote: The component calls Apex imperatively on Send. ... no app record writes ... This keeps the workflow to a single request and result with no independent worker lifecycle.
verdicts.missing: The spec chooses a synchronous foreground callout and never states the callout-after-DML or trigger constraint or an asynchronous (Queueable/future) design; it only notes revisiting if timing headroom is insufficient.

verdicts.quote: Protect the key in org-managed secret storage. ... Key values stay out of page data, responses, checked-in metadata and logs. ... use an enhanced Named Credential ... with a Custom External Credential

Salesforce documents a 120-second cumulative callout timeout per Apex transaction, 6 MB synchronous callout request/response size ... and current 10 MB synchronous Apex heap ... the external callout concurrency ceiling is 20.
verdicts.missing: CPU time limit and callouts-per-transaction limit are not named with numbers.

verdicts.quote: A controlled provider can expose exact requests and release held results independently of the bot, without a live account or billed inference.
verdicts.missing: It does not state that Apex tests cannot make real callouts and therefore need an HttpCalloutMock-style mock implementation.
